mostWorthwhile.text: Adding oxygen to the red cells was most worthwhile: the result explained both binding and release, and connected release to working tissues.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making plasma and adding white cells and platelets felt predictable, with little explanation beyond what the pictures showed.

surprise.text: The explanation that more oxygen can leave haemoglobin where dissolved oxygen is low helped me understand how the carrier serves working tissue.

arbitrary.text: The assembly steps had clear purposes, though adding white cells and platelets together left their individual roles unexplained.

continue.text: I would continue to see how circulation brings oxygen to the arm, although I hope for more meaningful choices than the mostly single-option assembly here.
